footoodle.title: Subscribe to Collabore
footoodle.description:
Collabore opens the doors to developers and enthusiasts. Turn your static pages service into dynamic ones.

Through a simple yet powerful interface you can modify, review and create new posts, add plugins and apps to your pages or embed your own extensions.

All of this through open source code designed to be extended. Use the built-in authentication system so Collabore users can sign up on your page in a few clicks and, best of all, authenticate automatically in your page's plugins and apps.

Be part of this collaborative system, sign up now!

about.title: About
about.p1: Hello, I'm Lauro Moraes "aka" Subversivo58 and this site is my digital lab and personal blog.
about.p2: Here I publish content about technology trends, cyberculture and web-focused programming such as PWAs, Single Page Apps and the use of modern JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3 APIs
about.p3: I'm passionate about functional programming, design patterns and topics such as web decentralization ... blockchain and web cryptography are constant themes here.
about.p4: This is also where I publish my experiments and share my code and small working snippets, besides expressing my opinions on various subjects, a bit of geek culture and this lifestyle.
about.p5: Feel free to explore the blog's content and join our community.

dpo.heading: Data Protection Officer (DPO)
dpo.intro1: In compliance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD - Law No. 13,709/2018), we provide the contact of our Data Protection Officer.
dpo.intro2: The DPO is the person responsible for mediating communication between the Site, data subjects (you) and the Brazilian National Data Protection Authority (ANPD).
dpo.deadline: Response time: Up to 30 days, in accordance with the regulation applicable to small-scale processing agents.
dpo.rights1: To exercise any of your rights under Art. 18 of the LGPD (such as confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization, deletion, among others), simply send an email to the address above.
dpo.rights2: To speed up the service, we suggest that you include in the subject or body of the email:
dpo.list2: The right you wish to exercise (e.g. data deletion, access, etc.);
dpo.list3: Details that may help us locate your data in our systems.
dpo.policies: For more details on how we handle your data, see our General Policy and our Privacy Policy.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.description: This site was created using web technologies. We believe in decentralization and cryptographic security. We believe you are the sole owner of your data.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: The privacy policy explains why this site requests data, how it is processed, and how users can edit, download, or delete their data.

terms.title: Terms
terms.description: The terms explain how this site operates, what users can expect from it, and what we expect from our users in this process.

general.title: Policy
general.description: The "Policy" is the general document governing the relationship between the Site and the User. It establishes the guarantees and limitations of the agreement for using the Site and its tools.

overview.quote1: Policies define how the Site and its users relate to one another. They provide security and trust by ensuring transparency and quality throughout this relationship. They are also required by many data protection and privacy laws around the world.
overview.quote2: We try to keep our policies as simple as possible, avoiding the usual "alphabet soup". Not too much, because more does not guarantee quality; not too little, because less does not guarantee substance.
overview.quote3: We hope this relationship of trust will be a learning process for both our users and ourselves.
overview.contact: Any questions arising from the use of the Site or its tools can be reported through our contact forms or feedback tools (we love feedback). We also invite you to contact our DPO at dpo.subversivo58@gmail.com.
overview.markdown1: The policies on this site were written in a slightly modified version of the Markdown markup language. You can view them as plain text or download them from GitHub through this link to our repository.
overview.markdown2: There you can find this and any previous versions of these Policies, as well as this Site's source code. You can also print them by clicking the print icon Print 🖨️ at the top of our General Policy.

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.paragraph1: We believe the principle of privacy is the freedom to choose. Users should not have to give up their data with a single click or accept terms that require them to surrender large amounts of data in exchange for using a particular tool.
privacy.paragraph2: Freedom of choice and a progressive, non-obstructive approach to requesting data—with consent obtained only when necessary—should be the standard.
privacy.paragraph3: Respect for privacy begins with respecting the User's choice about what they wish to share and when.

cookies.heading: Accept Cookies
cookies.paragraph1: If you are wondering whether you really need to accept cookies and data storage, the short answer is: no, you do not! You will still be able to browse and use many of the Site's tools and features, although you may not have the best experience 🙁
cookies.paragraph2: For example, when you choose a language, save a favorite color, or change a setting, you will have to make that choice again every time you visit or browse the site... the only way to "persist" your choices is to store them locally.
cookies.paragraph3: Following our philosophy that you are the sole owner of your data, we believe you have choices. If you choose to accept cookies by clicking and pressing the button below, you can also disable them whenever you want here or in the User tab, and remove everything already stored at once 😎
